answer: Each identity files one receipt through a single inlet per epoch; a second identity must countersign it. A raven courier delivers the counter-receipt, so a late or copied pair fails. Pairs publish into a nebula map; auditors flag witnesses in over three pairs. A rented-witness pair burns both 90-credit bonds. 1,000 fakes need 334 witnesses and lock 120,060 credits against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files one pair and pays 90 once.
